title: AMA MCP Tool Registration
description: Binds an out-of-process MCP tool to one or more agents' allow-lists. Backs FR-018, FR-019, FR-019a. Stored in the tool_registrations Cosmos container, partition key /tool_name. A new major version is a NEW document (NEW composite id), not an in-place update — preserves audit trail.

id.description: Composite key: <tool_name>:v<major>. Must match tool_name and pinned_major_version.

address.description: URL of the MCP server (HTTP-Streamable transport per ADR-033-04).

pinned_major_version.description: Major semantic version this registration binds to. The agent runtime refuses to invoke if the MCP server's serverInfo advertises a different major (typed version_mismatch error).

capability_description.description: Human-readable summary, surfaced in operator UI.

registered_by.description: Operator identity that registered this version.
